<!-- pr-reviewer: d96c8964b5f9d1cca901dc6fcb7134348002a9bf -->

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

What looks good:
- Small, focused change: the Component stack group now shows for a lathe-held tool (Turning, Groove, Thread, Form), with the same rows, Add, Remove, Apply, Detach and Swap as a spindle tool; the lathe root filter (`starts` in `crates/ui/src/state_component_views.rs`) keeps the empty stack from offering parts the lathe resolver refuses.
- The values row shows what the lathe resolver gives (gauge 0, inscribed circle as the diameter, nose radius, orientation) and never shows a corner radius the resolver does not derive; a refusal shows by name.
- The decision is recorded in `docs/decisions/3898-tool-library-components-3.md`, including the dropped items (no built-in lathe holders, no command change for refused stacks).
- Two pinning tests in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/tool_library_turning_stack.rs` cover the end-to-end stack (one undo step, undo/redo, swap offer) and the refusal-by-name path; the `#[test]` count of the `camcraft-ui` lib goes from 1766 to 1768, per the body (runner: lib step green).
- The new module has a provenance line; files stay under the 400-line limit; conventional subjects; `Fixes #3898` / `Fixes #3648` and a `Changelog:` line are in the body.

Results merged with main (self-hosted runner, run https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/45995428058; main eafe6aec6ec74ad34c5e0643648e2d97791ef149):
- Trial merge with main: clean (no conflicts).
- Quick gate: 18 steps, 0 failed (incl. `ui suites: lib`, 74 s, and the other ui suites).
- Clippy `-p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Head check: "The head is the one the reviewer read" passed.
- The runner's quick gate is green on the merged tree.

Targeted tests (step 5):
- Example catalog: not run; no post or toolpath changed.
- Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`, worktree off this head, merged with main): 6 ok (`light build (release --no-run)` 643 s, `motion light: lib` 362 s, 3 motion light steps, `app light: pocket_pass_start` 9 s). Zero failures. This is a local run, on Linux (release build).
- No heavy step owed: not a `P1` safety-floor PR; no posted G-code, collision or geometry change.
- The author's macOS light-lane note (6 ok) matches.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes (not blocking):
- The PR body reports one macOS ui lib failure (`setup_wcs_tests::the_combo_lists_the_setups_post_range_by_its_names`) that is also red on main per #4322. The runner's Linux `ui suites: lib` step is green, so this is an environment artifact, not this PR's regression; worth watching on the macOS lane.
- An empty stack of a Groove/Thread/Form tool offers lathe roots, and the resolver then refuses by name. That is the documented design (`docs/decisions/3898-tool-library-components-3.md`); a stricter offer filter would be a follow-up, not a blocker.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
